title: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization?
description: DSC 106 Project 2, with Ethan Dam and Sophie Xie. Using 33,358 NYPD misconduct allegations from ProPublica's CCRB release, we argue both for and against the claim that male officers face more consequences than female officers: men average more substantiated complaints and harsher recommended punishments, yet are promoted more often even after the harshest one. Oct 2026. Write-up

title: Whole vs. Processed Foods
description: DSC 106 Project 1. An expository visualization of GroceryDB comparing the price and macros of whole and processed foods. Oct 2026.

title: Outfit Visual Search
description: Text-to-image search over Fashionpedia garment photos using FashionCLIP and FAISS. In progress, Sep 2026. Code

title: Project Bioenergetics
description: A survey-weighted analysis of NHANES thyroid panels testing Ray Peat's bioenergetic hypotheses. Three of four pre-registered predictions failed, and the one significant result ran backwards. Aug 2026. Write-up Code

title: Power Outages and Population Density
description: Do higher-density states recover from power outages faster? A permutation-tested EDA and a Random Forest outage-duration model on 16 years of U.S. outage data show that it may not be significant. Jun 2026. Write-up Code
